name: Iris Windsor
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 1st year, Group C (Formerly: St. July Girls' School)
Favorite Food: Potato chips
Gift: Error Code (the ability to steal the opponent's five senses; she can disable up to 3 opponents at the same time)

Iris is Sakura's younger sister, and a really scary heroine. Not only she is very overprotective of Sakura, she even goes as far as to kill for her sake. She's extremely hostile towards Kyuushiro, and whenever Kyuushiro approaches Sakura, her killing intent gets stronger. Well, don't mess with the loli assassin.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
